message.content: I've spotted a mismatch in your discharge paperwork that needs flagging — I'll report it so we can keep things on track.
message.reasoning_content:
Need to analyze acceptance: discharge_summary draft waiting for st05, final needs st06 and data st05. Refund voucher draft waiting st16, final waiting st17a and st13.

But current workflow version 2 adopted. Need to check ward requirements r2 procedure text says discharge summary lists take-home medicines exactly as dispensed, including strength, quantity and substitution.

Workflow's discharge_summary sections: medicines needed_for draft, source record_kind take_home_order. That's conflicting - should be dispense_record.

Need to raise workflow conflict? Check definition element: section discharge_summary.medicines.

We have evidence events? Need to collect evidence ids. Requirements changed ev-08e0dcaa. Also need facts.

Also refund_voucher: required but workflow version? Check documents: refund_voucher preparable, but not conditioned? Actually ward_requires includes refund_voucher always. Workflow steps st17a/b have required_when null, so they are required. But check if conflict there? The other issue: requirements want clearance_slip and stay_bill but workflow says those documents not preparable_by agent? But they are still required? However acceptance only lists discharge_summary and refund_voucher.

But main conflict is medicines section source.

We must raise workflow conflict per instructions: cite requirement version in force (r2) and one definition element that conflicts.

Definition element kind section, id discharge_summary.medicines

We need version, requirement_version, explanation, evidence.

Version = workflow version 2

evidence array of ev ids: need at least one. Use ev-08e0dcaa and ev-a1c3f1e4 etc.

We also need to check if we should prepare documents after conflict? But acceptance conditions include refund voucher etc. However conflict raises that workflow definition is wrong; still need to proceed? Conflict doesn't block preparation.

But we should raise conflict.

After that, we cannot prepare discharge_summary draft until st05 completed. So ask staff doctor to complete clinical discharge.

We have asked twice earlier.

We can ask again (third time allowed per task max 3). We have already used 2 asks to doctor, 1 to pharmacist. So we have one left for doctor.

Should ask doctor: Please complete clinical discharge st05 with signoff_record.

Also refund needs st16 etc which needs st13 etc which not done. But we can wait.

Let's raise conflict first.
